name: Hugging Face Storage Buckets
migrationEase: High (S3-compatible gateway at s3.hf.co works with AWS CLI, boto3, s5cmd; also hf CLI sync/cp and HfFileSystem/fsspec)
gotchas: New product - egress pricing above the included ratio not published yet.

pricing.egressFree: Included up to 8x stored volume/month; CDN egress bundled at no extra cost

performance.throttle: Hub API rate limits apply (per plan); not published as S3-style req/s

dataProtection.replRPO: N/A (single home region; CDN pre-warm is a cache, not replication)

advancedS3.deltaIceberg: Via HfFileSystem + Spark/PySpark; no native S3 Tables

ecosystem.cdn: Built-in HF CDN (AWS + GCP pre-warm at launch)
ecosystem.nativeCompute: HF Spaces, HF Jobs (volume-mount buckets read-write)
ecosystem.nativeAnalytics: HfFileSystem (pandas, DuckDB, Polars, Dask, Spark, 🤗 Datasets via fsspec)
